header: Three backend changes editors see on day one
subheadline: These are real screenshots from a TYPO3 v14 backend with Desiderio installed.

items.title: See the page before you publish
items.description: All 244 elements have a backend preview built on Content Blocks 2.2, so the page module looks like the live page.

image.title: Desiderio page module previews
image.alternative: The TYPO3 page module showing Desiderio elements with their backend previews.
image.description: Screenshot of a TYPO3 v14 site with Desiderio.

items.title: Restyle the site without a deployment
items.description: Preset, dark mode, density, radius, container width and fonts are in the site settings. A brand refresh becomes an editor's task, not a development ticket.

image.title: Desiderio theme site settings
image.alternative: TYPO3 site settings showing the Desiderio theme options, including the preset.
image.description: Screenshot of a TYPO3 v14 site with Desiderio.

items.title: Give every campaign its own look
items.description: A theme preset field in the page properties applies to that page and its subpages. Each campaign, brand or section gets its own look.

image.title: Per-page theme preset field
image.alternative: TYPO3 page properties with the Desiderio theme preset field.
image.description: Screenshot of a TYPO3 v14 site with Desiderio.
